title.zh: 冀東石門發現 39.5 億年前岩石：冥古宙虧損地函與地球最古老隱沒作用的鐵證
title.en: China’s 3.95-Billion-Year-Old Rock Unveils Hadean Mantle Depletion and the Dawn of Subduction

summary.zh:
【總結】地質學家在華北克拉通冀東地區的石門雜岩中，發現了距今 39.5 億年前的奧長花崗質片麻岩（trondhjemitic gneiss）。這是目前全球已知僅次於加拿大 40.3 億年阿卡斯塔片麻岩（Acasta Gneiss）的第二古老岩石。這項突破性發現一舉化解了冥古宙地函是否早已發生分異的長年爭論，並提供了無可辯駁的岩石學與同位素證據，證實地球早在 39.5 億年前便已存在短暫的「板塊隱沒作用」雛形——將受低溫海水蝕變的表層洋殼快速帶入深逾 50 公里的地函高壓環境中熔融。

【研究問題】地球誕生於 45 億年前，但超過 39 億年的古老岩石極度匱乏。過去全球公認大於 39 億年的岩石僅有加拿大阿卡斯塔片麻岩，然而其平坦的稀土元素配分與負銪異常，顯示它是在淺層地殼、類似冰島的熱點地幔柱或撞擊熔融環境下形成的低壓產物，無法代表地球深部的構造運動。長久以來，科學界的核心謎團在於：地球何時開始出現能將表層物質拖入深部地函的板塊隱沒機制？此外，雖然短壽命放射性同位素 142Nd 暗示冥古宙已存在虧損地函（Depleted Mantle），但早期鋯石普遍缺乏正值的鉿同位素（εHf）訊號，導致地函早期分異的歷史充滿矛盾與未知。

【研究方法】研究團隊利用高解析度離子微探針（SHRIMP II），針對石門雜岩樣品中的鋯石進行精細的陰極發光顯微結構觀測與微區 U-Pb 同位素定年；隨後在完全相同的微區點位上，進行原位氧同位素（SHRIMP-IIe）、微量元素以及雷射剝蝕多接收電感耦合電漿質譜儀（LA-MC-ICP-MS）的鉿同位素測定。最後，團隊選用阿卡斯塔最古老的角閃岩成分作為基性原岩，運用熱力學相平衡模擬軟體（GeoPS）結合微量元素批次熔融模型，反演岩漿生成時的壓力、溫度、熔融程度與地溫梯度。

【結果】測定結果顯示該岩石結晶年齡為 39.51 ± 0.03 億年。岩漿鋯石的原位氧同位素偏高（δ18O 平均達 +6.77 ± 0.23‰），證實其玄武岩原岩曾在地表或近地表歷經低溫海水熱液蝕變；鋯石均一的正值鉿同位素（εHf(t) 加權平均為 +1.45 ± 0.27），則直接證實該玄武岩源自大於 43 億年前就已形成的冥古宙虧損地函。全岩微量元素與熱力學相平衡模擬更揭示，該岩漿是由玄武質洋殼在 >1.6 GPa（約 1.7 GPa，深度超過 50 公里）與 740–860 ℃ 下經 8–16% 低度部分熔融形成，對應低於 17 ℃/km 的冷地溫梯度。要將飽含水分的地表蝕變岩石快速輸送到 50 公里深處熔融，唯有類似現代板塊構造的「隱沒作用」能夠實現，這是迄今地球岩石記錄中最早的板塊隱沒直接證據。
summary.en:
**Summary:** Geologists have identified a 3.95-billion-year-old trondhjemitic gneiss in the Shimen Complex of eastern Hebei, North China Craton—making it the second-oldest rock formation ever verified on Earth, surpassed only by Canada's 4.03-billion-year-old Acasta Gneiss. Far more than a chronological curiosity, this ancient rock preserves a dual geochemical signature that resolves two foundational enigmas of planetary evolution: it delivers unequivocal proof that depleted mantle domains existed during the Hadean Eon, and it establishes the earliest petrological evidence that cold, surface-altered oceanic crust was plunged into the deep mantle along a cool thermal gradient via transient plate subduction.

**Problem:** Earth’s first half-billion years—the Hadean into the earliest Eoarchean—is nearly absent from the geological archive due to relentless crustal recycling. For decades, Canada's ~4.0 Ga Acasta Gneiss stood as humanity’s sole rock record from this primordial era. Yet, Acasta rocks formed under shallow, low-pressure conditions akin to modern Iceland or impact-induced sheets, offering virtually no evidence of deep geodynamic recycling. Major questions endured: Did the early Earth operate purely through stagnant lid or volcanic heat-pipe regimes, or had subduction already begun? Moreover, while short-lived 142Nd isotopic anomalies suggested early mantle differentiation, ancient zircons overwhelmingly lacked the positive hafnium isotope (εHf) signatures expected from a depleted mantle, leaving early crust-mantle evolution fiercely contested.

**Approach:** The authors analyzed three trondhjemitic gneiss samples discovered within granitic enclaves of the Shimen Complex. Using a Sensitive High Resolution Ion Microprobe (SHRIMP II), they determined high-precision U-Pb ages of oscillatory-zoned magmatic zircon cores. Crucially, they conducted co-located micro-analyses on the very same zircon domains to measure oxygen isotopes (SHRIMP-IIe), trace elements, and lutetium-hafnium isotopes (LA-MC-ICP-MS). Integrating these isotopic constraints with whole-rock geochemistry, the team performed thermodynamic phase-equilibrium modeling (via GeoPS with the HP622 database) and trace-element batch melting simulations, using Earth’s most primitive ancient basalts as starting materials to tightly bracket the pressure, temperature, and geothermal gradient of magma genesis.

**Results:** The zircon cores established a definitive crystallization age of 3951 ± 3 Ma. Magmatic zircons yielded uniformly positive initial εHf(t) values averaging +1.45 ± 0.27, providing rare, concrete proof of a juvenile basaltic precursor extracted from a depleted mantle that formed prior to 4.3 Ga. Their elevated δ18O values (averaging +6.77 ± 0.23‰) demonstrated that this basaltic protolith underwent low-temperature hydrothermal alteration at or near the surface. Strikingly, geochemical and thermodynamic modeling proved that the parental trondhjemitic magma was generated by low-degree (8–16%) melting at >1.6 GPa (~1.7 GPa, corresponding to depths >50 km) and 740–860 °C, along a remarkably low geothermal gradient (<17 °C/km). Sinking hydrated, surface-weathered oceanic crust deeper than 50 km along such a cool trajectory cannot be achieved through sagging or plume crustal delamination; it demands the rapid, deep burial intrinsic to early transient subduction.

keyArticle.title: Hadean mantle depletion and 3.95-Gyr subduction implied by North China rocks
